arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'bookings' AS source,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_at',b.confirmed_at,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',c.booking_id) AS row FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state AS charge_state,c.amount_cents AS charged_amount,e.event_id AS cancel_event,e.step AS cancel_step,(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings x WHERE x.client_reference=b.client_reference AND x.status='confirmed') AS confirmed_same_reference FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending'

SELECT 'pending' AS source,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'charge_state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key,'cancel',e.event_id) AS row FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_log',json_object('id',id,'message',message,'status',status,'path',path) FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' AND (message LIKE '%9c99ada05b9953d8b39ccc5d9cdf4614%' OR id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5))

SELECT 'charge' AS source,json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) AS row FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'early_log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'path',path,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs ORDER BY id LIMIT 30) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
